description: Typeset a document you wrote (markdown) as a PDF or DOCX on the firm's letterhead and file it in the matter's Dropbox folder. Never overwrites. Preview first; apply with confirm: true and the preview_id. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: Must be omitted or false on the first call — that only previews. Never invent a preview_id. After the person agrees, call again with confirm: true AND the preview_id this server returned.

file_name.description: Optional file name without extension. Must not already exist.

format.description: pdf (default) or docx for an editable copy.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result instead of writing again. Defaults to preview_id.

markdown.description: The document body you wrote, as markdown: headings, lists, bold/italic, quotes.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters.

preview_id.description: Exactly the preview_id this server returned on a prior call for these arguments. Required with confirm: true. Never generate or reuse one from another tool or conversation.

subfolder.description: Optional existing folder inside the matter folder.

title.description: Document title, printed under the letterhead. Also the file name unless file_name is given.

name: create_matter_document
title: Create document on letterhead
